Title: HTC-28350: SD Memory - Initialization
Purpose: Check if micro SD interface have a circuit to switch the power supply from 3.3V to 1.8V of the card when SD 3.0 protocol is initialized.

1.Expected: When the micro SD is initialized SD_VCCB should be 3.3V following SD 3.0 protocol.

2.Expected: When SDIO_1_SEL switches from LOW to HIGH, SD_VCCB should be 1.8V.
